div.head: II Em Prol. 1
div.ab: Ðonne ðuhte us ærest mæst ðearf, ðæt we ure gesibsumnesse ⁊ geðwærnesse fæstlicost us betweonan heoldan gynd ealne minne anwald.
Ðonne ðuhte us ærest mæst ðearf, þæt we ure gesibsumnesse ⁊ geþwærnæsse fæstlicost us betweonan heoldan gynd ealne minne anwald.
Et magnum nobis necesse uisum est, ut amicitiam nostram et boni diligentiam teneamus inter nos in toto regno meo.
Ðonne ðuhte us ærest mæst ðearf, þæt we ure gesibsumnesse ⁊ geþwærnesse fæstlicost us betweonan heoldan gynd ealne minne anwald.
Now, it has seemed to us first of all especially needful that we steadfastly maintain peace and concord among ourselves throughout all my dominion.
Erstlich nun däuchte uns zumeist nöthig, dass wir unsere Friedlichkeit und Eintracht zwischen uns festestens bewahren über all mein Gebiet hin.
First, then, it seemed to us most needful that we keep our peaceableness and concord among ourselves most firmly throughout all my dominion.
